purpose: Test policy-value identification, estimator robustness, and interval coverage before applying off-policy evaluation to an autonomous materials campaign.

dataGeneratingProcess.context: x1 and x2 are independent Uniform(-1,1); family is Bernoulli(0.5).
dataGeneratingProcess.targetPolicy: Choose action 1 when x2 + 0.4*x1 - 0.2*family > 0; otherwise choose action 0.
dataGeneratingProcess.behaviorPolicy: A clipped logistic policy depending on x1, x2, family, and the previous visible outcome; the exact action propensity is logged.
dataGeneratingProcess.outcomeDependentObservation: When enabled, q=0.25+0.50*outcome+0.15*I(x1>0), producing success-enriched missing-not-at-random records.

estimators.definition: Weighted least-squares outcome model evaluated under the target policy.
Inverse action-propensity policy value; when declared, also inverse-weights the outcome-observation probability.
Outcome-model target prediction plus inverse-weighted observed residual.

gates.rule: A point estimate is not causally eligible if target-action support is zero. Synthetic estimator success does not authorize claims about a real campaign.
